description: This file defines an Android Activity named ScoreboardActivity, responsible for displaying and managing the scoreboard UI in a tic-tac-toe game app. It handles UI initialization, score resetting, and updating score display.

classes.name: ScoreboardActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays game scores and provides functionality to reset scores and refresh display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and binds button click listener for resetting scores.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the scoreboard when activity resumes, ensuring scores are up-to-date.

methods.name: renderScores
methods.description: Updates the score display views and optionally announces score updates for accessibility.
